versions.subject: Add file_access_win_browser_credential_stealing
versions.detection:
selection:
    FileName|endswith: 
        - '\AppData\Local\Google\Chrome\UserData\Default\Network\Cookies'
        - '\Appdata\Local\Chrome\User Data\Default\Login Data'
        - '\AppData\Local\Google\Chrome\UserData\LocalState'
        - '\Appdata\Local\Microsoft\Windows\WebCache\WebCacheV01.dat'
        - '\cookies.sqlite'
filter_brower:
    Image|endswith:
        - '\firefox.exe'
        - '\chrome.exe'
filter_programfile:
    Image|startswith:
        - 'C:\Program Files\'
        - 'C:\Program Files (x86)\'
filter_antimalware:
    Image|endswith:
        - '\MsMpEng.exe'
        - '\MpCopyAccelerator.exe'           
condition: selection and not 1 of filter_*
versions.spl: FileName IN ("*\\AppData\\Local\\Google\\Chrome\\UserData\\Default\\Network\\Cookies", "*\\Appdata\\Local\\Chrome\\User Data\\Default\\Login Data", "*\\AppData\\Local\\Google\\Chrome\\UserData\\LocalState", "*\\Appdata\\Local\\Microsoft\\Windows\\WebCache\\WebCacheV01.dat", "*\\cookies.sqlite") NOT (Image IN ("*\\firefox.exe", "*\\chrome.exe") OR Image IN ("C:\\Program Files\\*", "C:\\Program Files (x86)\\*") OR Image IN ("*\\MsMpEng.exe", "*\\MpCopyAccelerator.exe"))
